sections.Profile:
The "Bowling Champ" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in February 1949, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Bowling, Sports, Original Theme
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Harry Mabs
- Art: Roy Parker
sections.Editions: - Bowling Champ: 2,419 made, released 1949-02-01, model number 18
